Esperamos que possam comparecer e participar desta grande competição, que será realizada pela primeira vez na Colômbia. Informações importantes: **[SAC 2026](https://www.speedcubingcolombia.org/pt/blog/sac-2026)** Esteja ciente de que durante o **WCA South American Championship 2026** haverá gravações e fotografias de forma frequente; portanto, ao participar do evento, você consente que sua imagem seja utilizada pela World Cube Association e seus parceiros em suas plataformas de marketing e redes sociais. # ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1ODgwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--89fe33b4e47263997451d2f790cd9ac7e9de0193/3.png) English Speedcubing Colombia (SCC) and the Ecuadorian Speedcubing Association (AES) present to everyone the largest and most important competition in the South American continent. We hope you can attend and take part in this great competition, which will be held for the first time in Colombia. Important info: **[SAC 2026](https://www.speedcubingcolombia.org/en/blog/sac-2026)** Be aware that filming and photography at the **WCA South American Championship 2026** will be prevelant, you therefore consent to your image being used by the World Cube Association and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending.
